newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ICICI 96/97 net up 62 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's ICICI 96/97 net up 62 pct.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI) said on Monday its 1996/97 (April-March) net profit after adjustments for the previous year rose to 7.7 billion rupees from 4.74 billion, up 62 percent.
The Bombay blue chip said profit after tax, but before adjustments, rose to 7.52 billion rupees from 4.36 billion.
The country's second largest term lending bank said disbursals for the year were 111.81 billion rupees.
ICICI merged with another term lender, SCICIO, last year.
It posted an earnings per share (EPS) of 16.30 rupees, and gave a dividend of 32.7 percent.
ICICI's net profit was higher than most analysts had expected.
On the Bombay Stock Exchange, ICICI shares closed at 59.50 rupees, up 1.75 from Friday's close.
